description.en: Facivermis yunnanicus. Evidence-informed stylization, not a specimen facsimile. Color, soft volume, exact posture and unpreserved details are interpretive. Possible pre-ocular appendages are omitted, not asserted absent. Tube composition and construction remain uncertain; the proposed animal-only asset does not claim a freely swimming or crawling lifestyle.
description.zh: Facivermis yunnanicus 的示意性活体复原，并非标本翻模。颜色、软组织体积及姿态为推定；未表现的眼前附肢不等于证实不存在。单独动物模型不暗示自由游泳或爬行生活方式。

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: Original muted natural palette; color artistic, not copied fossil mineral stains or reference pixels.

view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect cheap clay views for morphology, silhouette and attachment before final exactGLB four views.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB. Perspective and preview may reuse identical bytes.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a local view only for a specific unresolved issue.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website renderer/camera configuration has not been verified during prep. Keep canonical QA directions, do not claim website compatibility, and do not produce 768x432 derivatives here.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

acceptance_obligations: Verify exactly five bilateral anterior pairs and diagnostic whole-animal proportions in four exact-GLB views; no posterior appendage pairs.
Check simple paired ocular spots and posterior bulb/hook rows against referenced plates; add a close view only if the four canonical views cannot resolve them.
Portable embedded GLB and editable source must pass scoped technical checks; independent review is separate from preparation and making.
Record GPU, populated world, user acceptance and deployment as UNKNOWN until measured or explicitly established. Animal-only acceptance is not ecological scene readiness.
frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static whole-animal candidate for an Early Cambrian Chengjiang benthic region in a prehistoric 3D world. Animal-only, not a museum display; separately authored tube habitat is required for ecological scene use. No geometry exists in this preparation.

taxon.classification_scope: Luolishaniid lobopodian; stem-group Onychophora in Howard et al. 2020, not an annelid or a crown arthropod.
taxon.age_context: Early Cambrian, Series 2, Stage 3; Chengjiang context approximately 518 Ma in the cited paper.
taxon.geographic_context: Chengjiang Biota, Yunnan, China; Yuanshan Member, Chiungchussu Formation.
anatomical_anchors: HOWARD2020 Figures 1-3 actual pixels inspected; holotype NIGPAS 108720 and figured YKLP specimens.

scale.basis: Chosen representative proportions, not one measured specimen: paper reports body length about 0.028-0.09 m, head 0.001-0.0025 m, anterior lobopods about 0.0035-0.005 m.
scale.measurement_rule: Measure anatomical body centerline excluding limbs; do not mistake posed bounding-box length for body length. Record exported bounds separately.

pose.description: Gently curved upright feeding stance, rear anchor low and anterior limb-bearing region elevated. Keep left/right limb origins and posterior bulb inspectable. This is a tube-compatible interpretive pose, not direct fossil life-position evidence. No pedestal, seabed patch or tube included in this first animal-only candidate.
pose.scene_prerequisite: Place posterior and most of trunk within a separately authored dwelling tube before ecological scene presentation; do not depict unsupported exposed standing as verified behavior.

morphology.obligation: Ten tapered annulated lobopods: exactly five bilateral pairs on the anterior trunk, with circular ventrolateral bases, not head tentacles.
Two ventral setal rows on each lobopod. Simplify fine setae without replacing the appendages with broad paddles or walking legs.
morphology.location: Anterior-Lobopods; setae visible in Fig 3A/C. Fine spacing is not a fixed reconstruction claim.

morphology.obligation: Long narrow limbless middle trunk dominates length. Retain shallow annulations and restrained papillae/short setae, not a smooth naked tube or armored plates.
Pear-shaped posterior swelling with two or three hook rings and terminal anus. Use two subtle rings; no posterior leg pairs or tail fan.
Small ovoid head with two dorsolateral simple ocellus-like spots; terminal mouth slightly downturned. No eyestalks, compound eyes or head shield.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Ceilings only, not density targets. Spend geometry on diagnostic anatomy and continuous attachments; no hidden microdetail.

art_direction.construction: Long continuous softly faceted trunk, a small anterior fan of ten distinct tapered lobopods, and a quiet pear-shaped anchor end. Prioritize coherent attachment and negative spaces over uniform repeated detail.
art_direction.shape_hierarchy: Dominant elongated middle trunk; secondary anterior setose lobopods; tertiary posterior hook rings and small paired ocular spots. Keep broad trunk surfaces quiet.
art_direction.detail_policy: Setal and annular repetition is a visual simplification, not a counted segment or seta claim. Small appendages must have solid tapered volume and continuous bases; do not use disconnected spikes or flat fins.

world_use.role: Small tube-associated suspension feeder for an Early Cambrian Chengjiang benthic region.
world_use.placement: Actual centimeter scale; require a compatible tube and locality/time-matched habitat for scene use. Not a display stand, generic ocean swimmer or assumed contemporary of every prehistoric asset.
world_use.integration_boundary: Static animal candidate only. Tube habitat, rigging, animation, collision, LOD, GPU/populated-scene performance and deployment are unverified.
